create_BaseCompressor: create a BaseCompressor instance with a QuantizationConfig, model, tokenizer, and W4A16 scheme
quantize_and_save_model: quantize and save a PyTorch model to an output directory using the quantize_and_save method
save_quantized_model: save an already quantized model to disk in GGUF or auto_round format using save_quantized
resolve_quantization_scheme: resolve a quantization scheme string into concrete config attributes on the compressor via resolve_scheme
review_BaseCompressor_post_init: review the BaseCompressor post_init pipeline that resolves scheme, formats, patches model, and sets up hardware
